model-training.task.completed.evidence: API 22533 requires taskId and documents CREATING, RUNNING, STOPPING, WAITING (stopped), COMPLETED, FAILED and ENV_FAILED. A stopped task can be started through API 22514, so WAITING remains pending during startup and completion waits rather than causing an immediate failure. FAILED and ENV_FAILED fail; COMPLETED cannot satisfy a running wait.

model-training.task.running.evidence: API 22533 requires taskId and documents CREATING, RUNNING, STOPPING, WAITING (stopped), COMPLETED, FAILED and ENV_FAILED. A stopped task can be started through API 22514, so WAITING remains pending during startup and completion waits rather than causing an immediate failure. FAILED and ENV_FAILED fail; COMPLETED cannot satisfy a running wait.

model-training.task.stopped.evidence: API 22533 requires taskId and documents CREATING, RUNNING, STOPPING, WAITING (stopped), COMPLETED, FAILED and ENV_FAILED. WAITING means stopped rather than queued; stopped tasks cannot satisfy completion, and ended tasks cannot satisfy running.
